checks.details: Empty C-profile tables do not establish zero actual bpy C calls. Existing host counters and native explicit counters are retained.

default_latency_review.interpretation: Saved instrumented requests only. Inclusive host/profile spans overlap. Differences of medians are descriptive and do not add to a median end-to-end difference. Shared host source and prominent QA profiling do not establish the cause of the observed regression.

full_admission: pending root independent geometry review and explicit latency tradeoff review

scope.QA: Cold and changed oracles, registered change and unassigned close/control RPC remain in session totals. QA before/after probes and profiling scope are recorded separately. Profiling callback overhead cannot be subtracted from its inclusive execution scope.
scope.cold: First application geometry request in a fresh product/owned worker. OS caches retained. Two samples per original cold mode.
scope.content_encode: Existing mcp.content_encode includes relation display projection plus JSON/content preparation, not isolated json.dumps.
scope.native_comparison: FULL versus OFF plus native world vertices and triangles. Vertices-only has no equal-field native comparison.
scope.native_pair: sum_entry_elapsed adds sequential nonoverlapping OFF/native intervals. pair_window also includes the inter-call gap and native script preparation.
scope.peak: Recorded product-process OS lifetime high-water RSS. It includes earlier requests/setup in that process and is not a per-request allocation delta.
scope.timing_hierarchy: Entry wrapper includes Peer and its final receipt/RPC publication. Peer elapsed is sampled before that final publication. Trace and content-encode spans are inclusive. Nested measures are not added.
scope.warm: Five fixed cycles per original candidate session and one transformed cycle. OFF pair uses the same cycle.
